review_candidates.title: Technical Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: About us HS Wood Industries is an Egyptian joinery and custom furniture manufacturer specialising in luxury hospitality FF&E. We design, cost and produce fixed and loose furniture for five-star hotels, resorts and Nile cruises .Our clients are hotel operators, owners, interior design consultants and main contractors, and the quality of our numbers and our correspondence is a big part of why they come back. The role We are looking for a Technical Sales Engineer to join our commercial team. You will sit at the point where drawings become prices and where the client hears from us. Day to day that means reading tender drawings and BOQs, building up accurate costs for joinery and loose furniture packages, turning them into clear quotations, and then staying with the client through clarifications, revisions and award. This is a junior role and we will train you on our costing methodology and our furniture cost database. What we need you to bring is technical curiosity, comfort with numbers, and the confidence to write and speak to a hotel client professionally in English. What you will do Read and interpret architectural and interior shop drawings, specifications and tender BOQs for hotel projects. Prepare detailed cost build-ups for fixed joinery and loose furniture — materials, veneers, hardware, finishes, labour hours, wastage, transport and installation. Produce priced BOQs, quotations and commercial submittals, and keep every revision properly versioned. Maintain and extend our internal pricing database ( with real cost feedback from production and procurement. Send technical and commercial clarifications (RFIs) to consultants and hotel clients, and follow up until they are closed. Act as a day-to-day point of contact for client, consultant and main-contractor correspondence — emails, calls and meeting minutes. Support mockup room submissions: material samples, finish schedules, and the cost implications of client comments. Attend site visits and client meetings to take measurements, resolve technical queries and capture scope changes. Track variations and additional works, and price them promptly so nothing is delivered unpriced. Work closely with production, procurement and the design office so quoted costs match what the factory can actually build. What we are looking for 1–3 years of experience in estimation, technical sales, or project engineering. Furniture, joinery, fit-out or interior contracting experience is a strong advantage. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Industrial, Civil or Architectural), Interior Design, or Wood Technology. Ability to read technical drawings and take off quantities accurately. Strong Excel skills — formulas, lookups and structured cost sheets. AutoCAD literacy is required; 3D software (SolidWorks, SketchUp, Rhino) is a plus. Excellent written and spoken English. Hotel clients and international consultants are a large part of the audience, and your emails represent the company. Fluent Arabic for work with local suppliers, production and contractors. Organised and responsive — you chase your own open items rather than waiting to be reminded. Comfortable being corrected on pricing in the early months and learning fast from it. What we offer Direct exposure to major five-star hospitality projects from tender through handover.
